hero.title: Mia — Voice Task App
hero.subtitle: Speak tasks. See your day.
hero.tagline: A Flutter productivity shell with voice intents, AI enrichment, theme packs, and a multi-source Calendar that sits beside Mia tasks.
hero.impact: Voice is the differentiator — AssemblyAI + Gemini turn speech into structured tasks and calendar events, while Firestore keeps the guest/local agenda in sync with the Chrome capture extension.

problems.d: Typing every task breaks flow — voice should create structured work in one pass.
Tasks, calendar, and themes need clear boundaries without becoming separate apps.
Useful agendas should work from manual entry, voice, and extension capture — not only Google sync.
Week strips, now markers, filters, and indigo theming make the calendar feel like a real product.
